hero.heading: Superior Villa
hero.tagline: Vaulted ceilings, stone walls, and open-plan luxury

overview.body1: The Superior Villa is a masterclass in Caribbean craftsmanship — soaring vaulted timber ceilings, hand-laid stone walls, and an open-plan living and kitchen space that flows seamlessly to the outdoors. Designed for guests who appreciate both space and character.
overview.body2: Multiple bedrooms with king beds, a fully equipped kitchen, and generous living areas make this villa ideal for families or groups seeking a private retreat with all the comforts of home — and then some.
